description: Every intentional behavioral difference between QAE training selection and the characterized legacy selectors ([CTO-QAE-007] §G). PARITY mode reproduces legacy; anything else appears here with its approval. No hidden improvements.

deviations.legacyOutput: score ties ordered by String.prototype.localeCompare (host-locale ICU collation; hyphen treatment locale-dependent)
deviations.qaeOutput: score ties ordered by ordinal (code-unit) exerciseId comparison
deviations.reason: candidate order must never depend on locale; localeCompare is a characterized legacy determinism defect (registered L-TRN-1)
deviations.approvalReference: [CTO-QAE-007] §F — 'Candidate order must never depend on … locale … Final tie-break: stable exerciseId'
deviations.affectedFixtures: all 17 training goldens potentially; the parity proof compares score-buckets as sets and reports any observed sequence difference per fixture

deviations.legacyOutput: substitutionsFor returns declared alternatives in authoring order, then same-shape matches in catalog REGISTRATION order, capped at 3
deviations.qaeOutput: declaredSubstitutes stored sorted by exerciseId; same-shape family expressed as substitutionGroup (pattern:coarseMuscle); no registration-order dependence
deviations.reason: registration order is banned as an ordering source; Wave 1 freezes the data representation — picker-level substitution selection is Wave 2
deviations.approvalReference: [CTO-QAE-007] §F — 'Candidate order must never depend on: array registration order'
deviations.affectedFixtures: candidateSelection.substitutions in all 17 goldens (characterized legacy output preserved in goldens; QAE does not reproduce the ordering)

deviations.legacyOutput: two parallel legacy selectors: hardExclude/suitability/rank (personalization) and pool-filter + slot picking with machine-first alphabetical sort (shipping planGenerator)
deviations.qaeOutput: single declarative staged order: MovementPattern → RequiredEquipment → Safety → Difficulty → Stability → FatigueCost → preference/history scoring → deterministic rank, with stability and fatigue ceilings that have no legacy equivalent
deviations.reason: the approved architecture mandates one explainable order; safety and suitability outrank preference structurally
deviations.affectedFixtures: APPROVED_DEVIATION-mode results only; PARITY mode is unaffected and remains golden-comparable

deviations.legacyOutput: impact detection via English-name regex at selection time (legacy defect L-QST-6: /bike|row|elliptical|swim|walk/i over nameEn)
deviations.qaeOutput: the regex RESULT characterized once per exerciseId into metadata.contraindications ('impact' tag); selection reads the tag, never a name
deviations.reason: no localized-name dependence in selection; result-identical for today's catalog (proof asserts set equality)
deviations.affectedFixtures: none today (identical result set); future catalog additions get the tag at extraction, not at runtime

deviations.legacyOutput: shipping generator 'machines-only' pools for full/small gym (primaryMachineIdSet hard filter) alongside beginner machine-first candidate sort
deviations.qaeOutput: beginner machine-DOMINANT ranking preference (machinePolicy score part); machines are never a hard pool restriction in QAE-native mode
deviations.reason: directive names the policy explicitly: 'Beginner = machine-dominant policy, NOT machine-only absolute rule'
deviations.affectedFixtures: APPROVED_DEVIATION-mode candidate sets for gym scenarios include non-machine candidates that the legacy machines-only pool excluded; PARITY mode reproduces the legacy personalization selector, which never had the machines-only pool

deviations.legacyOutput: buildMuscleRankMap (planGenerator.ts:437) and sortCandidates (:414) order by String.prototype.localeCompare; the per-muscle rank map feeds partitionOrder, so under a different host ICU locale the A/B allocation — and therefore the assembled day content — can shift
deviations.qaeOutput: Domain/Training/assembly.ts orders by ordinal (code-unit) exerciseId in both buildMuscleRankMap and sortCandidates, and iterates muscle groups in ordinal key order so the rank map is independent of catalog registration order
deviations.reason: legacy defect L-TRN-2, same class as L-TRN-1/D1 but load-bearing for day assembly rather than candidate ranking. LATENT DEFECT CORRECTION, NOT A PARITY DIFFERENCE: on the current 181-exercise catalog every exerciseId is ASCII and ordinal collation agrees with the host locale, so all 17 goldens reproduce byte-identically (17/17). The deviation is registered because the DEFECT is real and would surface on a non-ASCII id or a differently-collating host; no parity difference is fabricated.
deviations.approvalReference: [CTO-QAE-013] §3 — if ordinal ordering produces identical current outputs, record L-TRN-2 as a latent approved defect correction and do not fabricate a parity difference
deviations.affectedFixtures: none observed — 17/17 assembled-day parity holds. Guarded by qae-assembly-proof: the D6 probe asserts ordinal and tr-TR collation genuinely differ on a probe set, so the equivalence is demonstrated to be catalog-specific rather than assumed universal.
